records.source: A word touching ``_`` or a digit is a piece of an identifier -- ``cell_area``, ``channel_1``, ``image_path`` -- and not a word of prose. Translating it rewrites a column name, a settings key or an SQL example into something that no longer names anything: the database browser's own example predicate, ``cell_area > 1000``, was shown to a Swedish user as ``Cell_area > 1000``, and the search hint offered ``'Kanal_1'`` for a column called ``channel_1``.

records.label: spacr.scorecard.read_scorecard_csv.number#1
records.source: A WHOLE NUMBER COMES BACK AS AN int. The CSV cannot distinguish a count from a measurement, and reading everything as float renders "on 12517.0 objects" in a tooltip -- a count with a decimal point reads as a rounding, which it is not.
records.context: A whole number comes back as an int. The CSV cannot distinguish a count from a measurement, and reading everything as float renders "on 12517.0 objects" in a tooltip -- a count with a decimal point reads as a rounding, which it is not.
records.translation: UN NÚMERO ENTERO SE DEVUELVE COMO int. El CSV no distingue un recuento de una medida, y leerlo todo como float muestra "on 12517.0 objects" en una información emergente -- un recuento con punto decimal parece un redondeo, y no lo es.
records.review_basis: Independent AI technical review against the English source; no native-speaker signoff.

records.label: spacr.scorecard.score_holdout.weighted#1
records.source: A plain mean would let a field with four objects count as much as one with four hundred, so a sparse corner of the plate could move the published number more than the plate does.
records.context: A plain mean would let a microscope field of view with four objects count as much as one with four hundred, so a sparse corner of the laboratory microplate could move the published number more than the laboratory microplate does.
records.translation: Una media simple haría que un campo con cuatro objetos contara tanto como uno con cuatrocientos, de modo que una esquina poco poblada de la placa podría mover el número publicado más que la propia placa.
